highlights: The perp entry cost is itemised per execution — drop the ones your position never paid, straight from the card
A single limit order is a plain order now: its receipt sticks, a cancel shows as pending, and a stuck deal can be unwedged
Token-margined markets show every leg's notional in token terms next to the dollars, in Opportunities and Positions
Each Boros leg in the opportunity details links to its market with the side prefilled
"Enable CrossEx" is its own onboarding step, before the API key and the funds
install.sh pins npm's prefix so a user ~/.npmrc can't hijack the yarn install
